summary: Dominari Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing inducement agreements with holders of Series A warrants to reduce overhang. Holders can either exercise all warrants at a reduced price of $2.20 per share (Option A) or exchange five warrants for one share of common stock (Option B). Expected proceeds from Option A are about $2.9 million; roughly 115,000 shares will be issued under Option B. Approximately 1.2 million warrants will remain outstanding. The exchange shares rely on Section 3(a)(9) exemption. Watch for execution before September 11, 2026 deadline and remaining warrant overhang.
